jobs.title: Analyst - Data Analytics & Network Evaluation
jobs.jd: Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers. Brown & Brown is seeking an Analyst – Data Analytics & Network Evaluation to join our growing team! The data analyst is responsible for collecting, processing, analyzing, and interpreting large datasets to extract actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making within an organization. This role involves utilizing analytical tools, statistical techniques, and programming languages to manipulate data and generate reports or visualizations. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and proficiency in data analysis tools are essential for success in this position. The ideal candidate must have a proactive approach to work, a problem-solving aptitude, and a willingness to learn and adapt to emerging industry practices. They should be motivated, well-organized, and a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment. Developing strong working relationships with clients and team members is essential. Additionally, the candidate will bring a flexible, positive, and solutions-oriented mindset to all aspects of the role. How You Will Contribute: Use statistical software and programming languages (such as Excel, SQL, R, or Python) to process and manipulate large datasets. Identify patterns, trends, and relationships within the data to support decision-making. Collect data from various sources, including databases, spreadsheets, APIs, and external repositories. Analyze datasets using statistical methods, machine learning algorithms, and data visualization techniques to identify patterns, trends, and insights. Build predictive models, clustering algorithms, or classification techniques to solve business problems and extract valuable insights from data. Evaluate model performance, validate results, and iterate models as needed to improve accuracy and effectiveness Prepare reports, presentations, and documentation summarizing analytical findings, methodologies, and assumptions. Utilize data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, matplotlib) to present complex data analysis results to key stakeholders in a clear and understandable manner. Customize visualizations based on audience requirements and preferences, highlighting key insights and trends. Skills & Experience to be Successful: Bachelor's degree in data science, computer science, statistics, mathematics, or a related field. Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with a solid foundation in mathematics and statistics. Proficiency in MS Excel and statistical software or programming languages (e.g., SQL, R, or Python). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to extract insights from complex datasets and drive actionable recommendations. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Qlik, Tableau, or Power BI) and techniques for creating charts, graphs, and interactive dashboards. Excellent attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets accurately. Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Aptitude for problem-solving and critical thinking, with a proactive and results-oriented approach. Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Previous internships, projects, or coursework in data analysis, statistics, or machine learning are advantageous. Demonstrated passion for data-driven decision-making and continuous learning in the field of data science. #LI-DA1 Pay Range $90,000.00 - $90,000.00 Annual The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role. Not reflective of all benefits. Enrollment waiting periods or eligibility criteria may apply to certain benefits. Benefit details and offerings may vary for subsidiary entities or in specific geographic locations. Recruiting Vendors must have a valid written agreement and received prior written authorization from an authorized Brown & Brown representative before submitting candidates for any publicly posted role. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Brown & Brown or its employees become the property of Brown & Brown, and no fees will be paid for such submissions. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd: This role focuses on discovering long-tail events in Zoox fleet driving logs by combining data mining techniques with the latest AI and Vision Language Model (VLM) capabilities. You will work with Zoox’s rich AV driving data, define what makes a driving moment interesting, build curated datasets of rare scenarios, and identify scenes with value for feature development, and public storytelling. Develop detailed scenario specifications and translate them into production level code to search AV fleet driving logs for long-tail events. Use the latest AI models and VLMs to filter candidate scenes. Review candidate scenes, take part in the end to end life cycle, improvement and maintenance of automated mining and triage tools. Build and maintain curated datasets of long-tail events that flag compelling scenes. Proficiency in Python and SQL. Hands-on experience with modern AI models or VLMs through APIs, coursework, or projects. Track discovery progress and communicate with stakeholders within and outside the core development team. Creative problem solving and strong communication skills. Experience with big data systems such as Spark. Robotics or AV data is a plus. Recommender systems and content curation. Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline. Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment. Able to commit a minimum of 20 hours per week. Able to work on-site at one of our office locations. Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.

jobs.title: Content Compliance Analyst
jobs.jd: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. CONTENT COMPLIANCE ANALYST We are looking for a legal analyst to join the SpaceXSI Legal team and help X and SpaceXSI to support our regulatory obligations across our products and jurisdictions. Typical examples include transparency reporting, regulator requests for information, risk assessments and audits. You will work with Legal, Compliance, Product, Safety and Engineering teams to identify, source and validate information and data in order to produce accurate, well-documented outputs that Legal and regulatory stakeholders can rely on. The role offers a real opportunity for impact in an agile, fast-paced environment. RESPONSIBILITIES: Curate and extract metrics and associated data required under, and as part of, regulatory obligations, such as transparency reports, regulator requests for information, risk assessments and audits. Translate legal and regulatory requirements into clear data definitions, and work with Legal, Compliance, Product, Safety, Trust & Safety and Engineering teams to source, validate and document the data needed. Build and maintain repeatable queries, pipelines and dashboards, so that recurring work does not depend on one-off requests. Own data quality, reconciliation, lineage and documentation, so that outputs are consistent and supported by a clear audit trail. Produce clear, accurate outputs for legal and regulatory use, and explain methodology and limitations to non-technical audiences. Handle sensitive and personal data in line with internal policies and data protection requirements, and improve tooling and processes, including better use of our artificial intelligence (AI) products. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics engineering or a quantitative role. Experience writing Structured Query Language (SQL) queries against large datasets. Experience using Python for data processing or automation. PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Experience with cloud data warehouses and business intelligence (BI) tools (for example BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Looker or Tableau), including query optimization and cost-aware querying of very large datasets. Ability to translate ambiguous legal or regulatory requests into precise, defensible data specifications - pinning down definitions, counting units, time windows, and scope before writing queries. A high degree of accuracy and attention to detail, with a methodical approach to validation and documentation. Ability to explain data and its limitations clearly to legal and other non-technical audiences. Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills across legal, engineering, and safety teams, including good instincts for when to escalate blockers and when to give stakeholders room. Ability to manage multiple concurrent requests with firm external deadlines. Sound judgement, integrity and discretion when handling confidential, privileged, and user level data.Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Experience at a technology, social media or AI platform. Experience supporting regulatory or transparency reporting, audits or regulator requests. Experience with privacy-aware data handling, such as data minimisation and access controls. Familiarity with online safety, platform, data protection or AI regulation. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: $80,000 - $110,000 USD Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. ITAR REQUIREMENTS: To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here . SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice .

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.jd: Astronics Connectivity Systems and Certification (formerly Telefonix PDT and Astronics Armstrong Aerospace) serves as the experienced, global market leader for in-flight entertainment and connectivity (IFEC) solutions for aircraft. As a systems certification provider, Astronics CSC has worked on over 100 projects for industry partners to upgrade commercial and business aircraft with new passenger power systems, IFEC navigation, communication and flight safety systems. Additionally, Astronics CSC offers proven IFEC hardware systems, flexible design platforms, high customer satisfaction, and long-term relationships with industry leaders to help make the connected aircraft a reality. The company now employs over 300 employees and is a six-time recipient of Chicago's Best and Brightest Employers to Work For award. Summary The Data Analyst supports the PMO by turning structured and unstructured data into actionable insights that drive program decision-making. This role bridges the gap between technology teams, business stakeholders, and PMO leadership by translating data needs into technical requirements, building reliable data pipelines and models, and delivering clear, compelling visualizations, dashboards, and reports. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical rigor with the ability to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Essential Duties and Responsibilities The essential duties and responsibilities include the following, other duties as may be required from time-to-time. Data Analysis & Insight Generation Analyze structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies relevant to program and project performance. Develop metrics, KPIs, and reports that support program-level decision-making and executive reporting. Conduct ad hoc and recurring analyses to answer specific business or program questions. Requirements & Stakeholder Collaboration Partner with the technology organization and business end users to understand data sources, definitions, and analytical needs. Translate business questions into clear technical and data requirements. Work closely with Program Managers to align analytics with project milestones, risks, budgets, and resource needs. Data Sourcing & Management Partner with Program Managers, Program Administrators, and Data Management Specialists to identify, map, and capture data from internal systems and external sources. Ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity across reporting and analytical outputs. Support the design and maintenance of data structures, taxonomies, and documentation used across the PMO. Modeling & Reporting Build and maintain statistical models to support ongoing monitoring and ad hoc deep-dive analyses. Validate model outputs and refine methodologies as data availability and business needs evolve. Data Visualization & Storytelling Design and maintain dashboards, reports, and presentations using data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar). Apply data storytelling techniques to make complex trends and patterns understandable and actionable for PMO leadership and stakeholders. Continuously improve visualization standards, templates, and self-service reporting capabilities. Information Architecture & Knowledge Management Design, implement, and maintain the information architecture across Sharepoint, Microsoft Teams, network drives, and other collaboration platforms to ensure the information is intuitive, organized, and easily accessible. Eliminate redundant files, duplicate dashboards, obsolete documents, and disconnected repositories to create a single source of truth for program and operational information. Perform periodic audit of digital repositories to identify outdated, duplicate, or conflicting information and coordinate cleanup activities with content owners. Support the implementation and continuous improvement of Sharepoint, Microsoft Teams, Power BI, and other digital collaboration tools to improve organizational effectiveness. Cross-Functional Support & Continuous Improvement Serve as a data resource within the PMO, supporting Program Managers, Program Administrators, and Data Management Specialists with data-driven insights for status reporting, forecasting, and risk/issue tracking. Contribute to process improvements related to data collection, reporting cadence, and analytical rigor across the PMO. Qualifications To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Required: Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience). 2–4+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role. Proficiency with SQL and at least one data visualization tool (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, etc.). Experience working with both structured (databases, spreadsheets) and unstructured (text, logs, documents) data. Strong understanding of statistical concepts and basic modeling techniques. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present data insights to non-technical audiences. Preferred: Experience supporting a PMO, program/project management function, or portfolio reporting. Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Smartsheet, ServiceNow). Experience with Python or R for data manipulation and statistical analysis. Understanding of data governance, data management principles, or ETL processes. Exposure to Agile/Waterfall program delivery frameworks. Work Environment The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Personal Protective Equipment may be required when working in designated areas. The noise level in the work environment is moderate. jobs.title: HR - Delivery Excellence Analyst
jobs.jd: Meriton is a national team of experts driving HVAC innovation through a network of high-performing companies. From strategy and support to systems and solutions, we work behind the scenes to strengthen operations and build value—for our partners and our people. If you’re looking to make an impact, we’re glad you’re here. At Meriton, you’ll join a team that believes in big ideas, doing great work, and building careers that matter—every step of the way. Position Summary: The Delivery Excellence Analyst focuses on the effectiveness of the system behind People service delivery. This role analyzes processes and operational data, develops reporting and dashboards, maintains SOPs and process documentation, supports compliance controls, identifies root causes and improvement opportunities, and helps design more efficient and scalable ways of working. Working closely with the Director, Delivery Excellence, People Experience Specialists, and partners across the People function, the Analyst helps ensure that People programs are supported by reliable data, clear documentation, and sound operational controls as Meriton continues to grow. Key Responsibilities: Process & Operational Analytics • Analyze People processes and operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and root causes. • Translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for the Director, Delivery Excellence and process owners. • Monitor volume, cycle time, service-level, and quality metrics across key People processes. • Support prioritization of process-improvement initiatives using data rather than anecdote. Reporting & Dashboards • Build and maintain operational dashboards and reports that provide visibility into service delivery, compliance, volume, trends, and risk. • Ensure reporting is accurate, timely, and easily understood by People Team leaders and business stakeholders. • Partner with People Technology and IT to automate recurring reporting where possible. SOP & Process Documentation • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process maps, RACIs, and job aids for key People processes. • Keep documentation current as policies, systems, and processes change. • Support version control and governance of process documentation in line with enterprise standards. Compliance & Controls Support • Support compliance calendars, controls, and monitoring processes for People-related requirements. • Assist with internal reviews and audits of People practices and records. • Help identify operational and compliance risks and support development of mitigation plans. Continuous Improvement • Participate in process redesign efforts aimed at improving employee experience, efficiency, and scalability. • Help gather feedback from People Team members, employees, and leaders on service effectiveness. • Identify opportunities to centralize, standardize, automate, or simplify administrative People activities. Cross-Functional Collaboration • Partner with People Experience Specialists, PSPs, PBPs, COEs, Payroll, Finance, and IT to resolve recurring service-delivery issues. • Support the Director, Delivery Excellence in preparing materials for operating reviews and leadership updates. • Escalate issues that cross functions or cannot be resolved within established service channels. MEASURES OF SUCCESS Success in this role should be demonstrated through measurable improvements in: • Accuracy, timeliness, and clarity of dashboards and reporting • Quality and currency of SOPs and process documentation • Timely completion of assigned compliance and audit support activities • Quality of root-cause analysis and improvement recommendations • Responsiveness to People Team and stakeholder requests • Contribution to measurable process-efficiency gains QUALIFICATIONS Required • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Analytics, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. • 2+ years of experience in HR operations, People analytics, process improvement, or a shared services environment. • Strong Excel skills and comfort working with operational and HR data. • Experience developing or maintaining process documentation (SOPs, process maps, job aids). • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple priorities. • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including translating data into plain-language insights. Preferred • Experience with HRIS platforms, workflow/case-management tools, or BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau). • Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma, or other process-improvement methodologies. • Experience supporting a multi-location or rapidly growing organization. • Familiarity with federal and state employment compliance requirements. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • Detail-oriented. Catches inconsistencies and errors in data and documentation before they become problems. • Curious. Digs past the symptom to understand why a process isn't working. • Organized. Keeps documentation, dashboards, and recurring tasks current without reminders. • Collaborative. Works effectively with People Experience Specialists, COEs, and business stakeholders to get things done. • Improvement-minded. Looks for better, simpler, more scalable ways of working, not just the next task on the list. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship. jobs.title: People AI Operations Specialist
jobs.salary: $110K – $150K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • Multiple Ranges
jobs.jd:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.



The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.




OPERATING PRINCIPLES

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

 1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

 2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

 3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

 4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.




AI-FIRST BY DEFAULT

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

 - Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.

 - Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.

 - Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

 - Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.



About the Role

We are building the next generation of People Operations at Deepgram. We're looking for a technically strong, AI-native builder to partner directly with our Director of People Operations to identify, design, build, and maintain AI-first workflows that fundamentally change how People and Talent operate, and then share what works with other teams across Deepgram.

This isn't a traditional systems or Operations admin role. You'll own the systems that sit on top of and between our People tools: connecting and configuring them through APIs, webhooks, and workflows, and turning manual, repetitive, high-friction People processes into intelligent workflows using AI, automation, internal tools, and agents. Just as importantly, you'll debug, maintain, and scale what you build so it keeps working as Deepgram grows.

You'll sit within People Operations and partner with Talent, IT, Security, Finance and other key functions to build secure, scalable solutions that allow team members and managers to get answers and complete workflows without requiring a People team member for every interaction.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who loves building, experimenting, and turning operational chaos into order. You might be an early-career engineer, a career resetter, or a People Ops or talent operations professional who taught yourself to code and automate. What matters is what you can build, and that you want to build it for People.


What You'll Do

 - Partner directly with the People Operations and Talent teams to identify high-impact opportunities to apply AI and automation across systems.

 - Turn manual People workflows into automated, AI-powered systems.

 - Build AI agents and workflows that can answer questions, gather information, initiate processes, and complete defined actions.

 - Integrate AI systems with existing tools, including Ashby, Slack, Metaview, BambooHR, Lattice, Pave, Carta, and other internal systems.

 - Configure and connect our People tools beyond AI, including Ashby workflows, webhooks, APIs, and vendor integrations, so the team can move faster without relying on vendor support and walkthroughs.

 - Integrate AI systems with existing processes, including recruiting, onboarding, performance, and compensation.

 - Build an AI-first virtual onboarding experience that is scalable, and provides an exceptional team member experience.

 - Build internal tools and interfaces that make People processes dramatically easier for employees, managers, and the People team.

 - Prototype quickly, test with real users, learn from what works, and iterate.

 - Establish appropriate human-in-the-loop controls, escalation paths, permissions, and safeguards for sensitive People workflows.

 - Partner with Engineering and IT on architecture, security, access controls, and productionizing successful prototypes.

 - Measure whether what you build actually saves time, improves the employee experience, or increases the quality and consistency of People Operations.

 - Build people analytics and dashboards (e.g., ARR per employee, manager-facing performance insights) and share information responsibly, protecting sensitive employee data.

 - Debug, maintain, and scale the systems you build, document them so others can maintain them, and share proven approaches with other teams across Deepgram.

 - Handle sensitive employee information and unreleased work with sound professional discretion.

Experience

 - 1–3 years of experience in software engineering, automation, internal tools, technical People or talent operations, or a similar role. Self-taught, hands-on experience building and shipping real tools counts just as much.

 - Working proficiency in Python and SQL (TypeScript/JavaScript or Apps Script a plus), and comfort working with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON.

 - Familiarity with People systems such as BambooHR, OysterHR, SequoiaOne, Ashby, Metaview, Lattice, Pave, Carta, and Ethena is a plus; you can learn the specific tools on the job.

 - Familiarity with our collaboration and identity stack (Slack, Notion, Glean, Google Workspace, and Okta) is a plus.

 - Experience building dashboards, reporting, or people analytics, as well as bots, agents, apps, workflows, internal knowledge bases, or ticketing and service-desk automations.

 - Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI tooling, such as prompt design, tool/function calling, webhooks, MCP, or agent frameworks.

 - Experience connecting SaaS systems through APIs or automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Workato, n8n) to automate workflows end to end.

 - Clear communicator who can explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical partners and document what you build so others can maintain it.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and a bias for action. You prototype quickly, ship, and iterate based on feedback.

 - Highly organized. You enjoy bringing order to messy processes and can project manage your own work from idea to launch.

 - Excited to build your career at the intersection of People and technology, with your work centered on People and Talent.

Development of high performing, comprehensively documented analytics and modelling solutions, demonstrating their efficacy to business users and independent validation teams. Implementation of analytics and models in accurate, stable, well-tested software and work with technology to operationalise them. Provision of ongoing support for the continued effectiveness of analytics and modelling solutions to users. Demonstrate conformance to all Barclays Enterprise Risk Management Policies, particularly Model Risk Policy. Ensure all development activities are undertaken within the defined control environment. Assistant Vice President Expectations To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions. Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others. OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes. Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues. Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda. Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done. Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function. Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy. Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively. Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience. Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes. All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave. What will you be doing? Barclays Services Corp. seeks Quantitative Analyst Risk Modeler in New York, NY (multiple positions available): Design, develop, and optimize quantitative risk solutions supporting IFRS 9 and CECL expected credit loss (ECL) frameworks, ensuring seamless integration with enterprise risk platforms and data pipelines. Implement scalable, production-grade Python and SQL applications that automate data processing, model execution, and reporting while maintaining high performance, reliability, and operational stability. Evaluate system performance through back-testing, benchmarking, and monitoring of model outputs, identifying optimization opportunities to improve computational efficiency and business usability. Build risk solutions that integrate effectively into existing systems and processes while delivering strong and consistent performance. Create project designs; develop predictive models and strategies; and create production code for model implementation. Work closely with the technical disciplines of the Internal Governance and Control Team, Internal Validation Unit, Model Monitoring to ensure that the latest methodologies and constraints are incorporated in the acquisition, capital and impairment plans and to provide efficient documentation around the process to ensure smooth audit. Produce comprehensive documentation to ensure the models can be replicated and to indicate how the models adhere to internal, external and regulatory requirements. jobs.jd: Who We Are: At Avnet, relationships matter. Job Summary Develops and maintains data pipelines and scalable data-processing solutions that transform diverse source data into trusted, usable information for business applications, analytics, and AI. Integrates, cleanses, models, and enriches large datasets from enterprise systems, APIs, external providers, and unstructured documents. Applies data engineering and machine learning techniques to improve data quality, automate classification and extraction, and support reusable, governed data products that advance business initiatives. Principal Responsibilities Develops, maintains, and troubleshoots automated data pipelines to ingest, transform, and integrate data from enterprise systems, APIs, files, and external sources. Uses Python, SQL, and distributed processing frameworks such as Apache Spark to prepare and process large datasets in cloud platforms such as Databricks. Implements data cleansing, normalization, deduplication, reconciliation, and validation logic to improve the consistency, completeness, and reliability of consolidated datasets. Supports the development, testing, and application of machine learning models for product classification, attribute mapping, data enrichment, and other automation use cases. Processes structured and unstructured content, including product records, technical documents, and associated digital assets, using programmatic extraction and AI-assisted methods. Builds and maintains data models and curated datasets that support downstream applications, search, analytics, and AI solutions. Monitors pipeline execution and data quality; investigates failures, resolves discrepancies, and contributes to improvements in processing performance and reliability. Applies established data governance, access-control, metadata, and documentation standards to support traceable and maintainable data solutions. Collaborates with technical teams and business stakeholders to translate requirements into practical data solutions and communicate results, limitations, and business value. Other duties as assigned. Job Level Specifications Foundational knowledge of data engineering, programming, database concepts, and machine learning , acquired through academic instruction, projects, or relevant work experience. Develops solutions for defined data-processing and integration tasks using established architectures, tools, and engineering practices. Performs assigned work with increasing independence, exercising judgment in troubleshooting and implementation. Receives guidance on complex technical decisions, with work reviewed for accuracy and quality. Collaborates with team members and stakeholders to understand data requirements, resolve issues, and deliver usable results. Contributes to the quality and reliability of assigned pipelines, datasets, and analytical solutions; recognizes when issues require escalation or additional expertise. Work Experience: Typically less than 2 years with bachelor's or equivalent. Education and Certification(s): Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained. Distinguishing Characteristics: Hands-on experience with Python and SQL , including academic, internship, or project-based experience. Experience with data transformation, relational databases, and automated data processing. Exposure to Databricks, Apache Spark, cloud data platforms, machine learning libraries, APIs, and version control preferred. What We Offer: Our employees work hard to live our values and help us grow. Our total rewards strategy supports Avnet’s ability to attract, engage, develop, and reward our employees, while promoting a diverse and inclusive environment. We offer competitive compensation and benefit programs — from time away and flexible working arrangements to programs supporting employee well-being and opportunities to give back to your community. This role supports quality control, operational analysis, and reporting activities within a highly regulated fintech environment. This role helps improve process performance, reporting accuracy, and control effectiveness by gathering business requirements, analyzing operational data, documenting processes, and producing insights for internal stakeholders. Working with more experienced analysts, managers, and cross-functional partners, contributes to service quality measurement, trend analysis, governance support, and continuous improvement initiatives across business operations. Job Description Position Summary The Project Analyst is a member of the Data & AI Policy & Governance team and is responsible for improving how governance requirements are designed, implemented, and adopted across the enterprise. This role combines policy analysis, data analytics, process improvement, and AI innovation to evaluate how governance requirements perform in practice, identify opportunities to improve effectiveness and usability, and help translate policy into scalable operational capabilities. Evaluate governance outcomes, implementation challenges, stakeholder feedback, and operational metrics to identify opportunities for improvement. Determine whether implementation challenges stem from policy design, process execution, technology limitations, or organizational factors. Recommend enhancements to policies, standards, guidance, and governance frameworks that improve effectiveness, scalability, and user experience while maintaining appropriate risk management objectives. Develop metrics, reporting, and insights that support data-driven policy decisions and demonstrate governance effectiveness. Support the development of implementation guidance, playbooks, and supporting materials that improve consistency and adoption. AI & Digital Governance Enablement Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and agent-based capabilities to improve governance processes and user experiences. Translate policy requirements into machine-consumable knowledge, decision logic, workflows, and governance capabilities. Design, prototype, or support AI-enabled solutions that help users navigate governance requirements and make informed decisions. Build or support AI agents, copilots, knowledge solutions, and workflow automations that operationalize policy requirements. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical applications that improve governance effectiveness and scalability. Stakeholder Collaboration & Requirements Management Partner with Privacy, Legal, Risk, Security, Technology, Product, and operational governance teams to understand implementation challenges and opportunities for improvement. Gather, document, and prioritize requirements for policy enhancements, reporting capabilities, AI-enabled solutions, governance tooling, and process improvements. Translate analytical findings and stakeholder needs into actionable recommendations and implementation plans. Support adoption and change management activities associated with governance initiatives and new capabilities. Experience building or supporting AI agents, copilots, automation solutions, or other AI-enabled business capabilities. jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst - Market Data
jobs.jd: Role Profile LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. We enable financial markets around the world through trusted data, technology and market infrastructure. Data Collection Development Americas develops and supports real-time systems that collect, process and distribute financial market data from stock exchanges and other data providers across the United States, Canada and Latin America. The Business Analyst works at the intersection of financial markets, data and technology. The role involves developing expertise in assigned market data feeds, analyzing stock exchange specifications and notifications, gathering and documenting business and technical requirements, supporting testing, and helping deliver market changes into LSEG's production systems. Responsibilities Develop knowledge of assigned stock exchanges, market data feeds, asset classes and market structure. Review and interpret stock exchange specifications, technical documentation, market notices and vendor communications. Monitor stock exchange and contributor notifications and assess potential impacts to LSEG products, services and customers. Gather, analyze and document business, functional, technical and data requirements. Translate stock exchange specifications and market behavior into clear requirements for Software Engineers and other technical teams. Analyze messages, fields, data types, identifiers, mappings, code sets and market rules. Create and maintain product specifications, data mappings, test cases and technical documentation. Validate market data against requirements, stock exchange specifications and expected market behavior. Investigate data discrepancies and support root-cause analysis, regression testing and production readiness. Work with data using tools such as Excel and SQL, with opportunities to use Python or similar scripting languages for analysis, validation and lightweight automation. Use approved Generative AI and AI-assisted tools to support specification analysis, requirements drafting, data exploration, test-case development and knowledge discovery. Critically review and validate AI-generated outputs and use AI responsibly in accordance with LSEG policies. Work collaboratively with Business Analysts, Product Delivery Managers, Software Engineers, Quality Assurance, Product and Operations teams. Manage multiple assignments and priorities in a fast-paced, real-time market data environment. Skills & Requirements Strong analytical, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. High attention to detail when working with data, specifications and testing. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to understand and organize complex technical information. Foundational financial markets literacy, including an understanding or interest in equities, fixed income, derivatives and other asset classes. Understanding or interest in developing knowledge of trades, quotes, bid/ask prices, order books/market depth, reference data and trading sessions. Strong data literacy and familiarity with structured datasets and data analysis. Proficiency with Excel or similar analytical tools. Ability and willingness to develop skills in SQL, Python, APIs, data visualization and AI-assisted analysis. Ability to learn new financial, market data and technical concepts quickly. Ability to work effectively within cross-functional and Agile delivery teams. Desired Skills Degree or equivalent experience in Business, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related discipline. Interest in global financial markets, financial technology and real-time market data. Exposure to SQL, Python, Power BI, APIs, JSON/XML or other data-analysis technologies. Familiarity with Generative AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and an understanding of responsible AI use. Experience with data-intensive, real-time or production systems is beneficial. Exposure to Agile software development and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence or SharePoint is beneficial. The successful candidate will progressively become a market data and market logic subject-matter expert for assigned feeds while developing strong business analysis, technical, financial markets, data and AI capabilities. Career Stage: Senior Associate LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy. Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions. Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance. Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy. Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops. Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you. We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. jobs.title: Associate, AI Solutions & Enablement
jobs.jd: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 08 The Team: Enterprise Solutions is building a new AI team to turn ambitious ideas into practical solutions used across a global business. Each Associate will align with a business line or function while collaborating as one team across New York, London, and Dallas. As part of this new team, you will help shape its ways of working, technology, and standards while developing AI solutions with the potential to scale across Enterprise Solutions. You will have access to S&P Global’s data, market expertise, and complex, real-world business challenges. The Associate, Applied AI Solutions is a hands-on builder role for someone who wants to explore what AI can accomplish in practice. You will identify high-value opportunities, rapidly prototype and rigorously validate ideas, and help deploy AI-enabled solutions that business teams trust and use. Responsibilities and Impact: Discover and diagnose business processes: Partner with teams across Enterprise Solutions to map workflows, identify inefficiencies, and determine which business problems are suitable for AI or automation. Design, build, and test AI solutions: Create and iterate on prompts, agent workflows, assistants, and automation concepts using modern AI tools, Microsoft 365, Python, JavaScript, PowerPoint, and related analytics technologies. Validate solutions rigorously: Evaluate outputs for accuracy, reliability, usefulness, and repeatability; identify failure modes; and clearly document the limits of what each solution can be trusted to do. Measure and communicate impact: Quantify time saved, manual steps reduced, error rates improved, and other business outcomes. Present findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and Enterprise Solutions leadership. Document solutions and enable adoption: Develop process documentation, playbooks, user guides, and support materials. Lead walkthroughs, office hours, and training sessions that help business teams use solutions effectively and strengthen their AI fluency. Build for repeatability and scale: Contribute shared prompt patterns, templates, evaluation methods, and starter kits. Take increasing ownership of business problems from discovery through delivery and help move successful pilots into repeatable operating practices. First-Year Expectations Days 1–30: Orientation and Immersion Learn the Enterprise Solutions landscape, data environment, tooling, governance expectations, and current AI enablement priorities. Shadow live business processes and develop hands-on familiarity with internal AI platforms. Days 31–90: Capstone Build Scope, build, and test an AI solution for a real business problem with support from a project sponsor and mentor. Demonstrate practical value, document the solution clearly, and present results and recommended next steps to Enterprise Solutions leadership. Months 4–6: Depth and Repeatability Contribute to additional use cases, improve reusable team standards, support stakeholder enablement, and demonstrate consistent judgment in solution design, testing, documentation, and business adoption. Months 7–12: Autonomous Execution and Scale Take increasingly independent ownership of business problems from discovery through delivery. Manage stakeholder relationships with appropriate guidance, identify opportunities for scalable reuse, and help move successful solutions from pilot concepts into repeatable operating practices. Compensation/Benefits Information: S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $85,000 to $90,000. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please visit the applicable benefits summary here . What We’re Looking For: Basic Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, technical, or business discipline, including Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Business Analytics, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field. Demonstrated hands-on experience using modern AI technologies, such as Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, large language models, AI assistants, or agent-building tools, to complete practical work. Demonstrated data analytics capability, including the ability to structure, clean, and analyze data and draw defensible conclusions. Working proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to use these tools for analysis, validation, and clear communication. Additional Preferred Qualifications: Experience using Python, JavaScript, Microsoft 365, automation tools, or related analytics technologies to build prototypes or working solutions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nontechnical audiences. Strong attention to detail, with a bias toward verification, systematic testing, and evidence-based conclusions. Comfort partnering directly with business stakeholders to understand workflows, ask effective questions, and translate business needs into practical, buildable solutions. Basic understanding of and/or experience with Capital Markets workflows Right to Work Requirements: This role is limited to persons with indefinite right to work in the United States. About S&P Global Market Intelligence At S&P Global Market Intelligence, a division of S&P Global we understand the importance of accurate, deep and insightful information. Our team of experts delivers unrivaled insights and leading data and technology solutions, partnering with customers to expand their perspective, operate with confidence, and make decisions with conviction. For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/marketintelligence . What’s In It For You? Our Mission: Advancing Essential Intelligence. jobs.jd: A path for every ambition. At HUB, we believe the best work happens when people are given real space to grow and then given the autonomy to exercise it. We power progress and protect ambition: for the clients who count on us, and equally for the people who make that possible every day. We’re creative thinkers and determined doers, guided by values that show up in how we work together: with empathy, adaptability, accountability and a genuine commitment to one another’s success. We foster bold ideas, celebrate curiosity and share what we know. Because when people grow, the work they do grows with them. Our purpose is deeply human: to help people navigate the world on their terms, at their speed, toward their future. We hold that same commitment to the people building careers here. Whether you’re starting out or leveling up, you’ll find the resources to evolve, the support to take on more and a team ready to back you at every stage. Your ambition has a home here. ABOUT US At HUB International, we are a team of entrepreneurs. We believe in protecting and supporting the aspirations of individuals, families, and businesses. We help our clients evaluate their risks and develop solutions tailored to their needs. We believe in empowering our employees to learn, grow, and make a difference. Our structure enables our teams to maintain their own unique, regional culture while leveraging support and resources from our corporate centers of excellence. HUB is a global insurance and employee benefits broker, providing a boundaryless array of business insurance, employee benefits, risk services, personal insurance, retirement, and private wealth management products and services. With over $5 billion in revenue and almost 20,000 employees in 700 offices throughout North America, HUB has grown substantially, in part due to our industry leading success in mergers and acquisitions. Position Summary The Pharmacy Analyst will serve as a core analytical resource within HUB’s national pharmacy analytics team, delivering data-driven analyses and reporting that drive pharmacy benefit consulting decisions across all markets. This position is responsible for executing sophisticated pharmacy analyses, producing actionable client-ready reports, and translating complex claims and utilization data into clear insights for Regional Pharmacy Directors and field teams. The successful candidate brings strong analytical instincts and pharmacy data expertise and thrives in a fast-paced environment where rigorous, timely analysis directly shapes the advice clients receive on their pharmacy benefit strategies. Key Responsibilities RFP Analytics & Financial Modeling Lead the financial and analytical evaluation of PBM proposals, turning vendor responses into clear, comparable insights for plan sponsors. Utilize financial models and cost projections to compare pricing structures, contract terms, and program options. Identify discrepancies, gaps, and terms that need vendor clarification, and make sure evaluations are consistent and defensible. Analyze pharmacy benefit data from multiple sources, including claims, utilization, clinical program, and market data, to uncover trends and savings opportunities. Support strategic recommendations by quantifying the financial impact of vendor, contract, and plan design decisions. RFP Process Management Coordinate RFP timelines across multiple PBM vendors per engagement, including distributing questionnaires, tracking responses, and managing finalist rounds. Evaluate vendor questionnaire responses using weighted scorecards and summarize strengths, gaps, and risks. Maintain the practice’s RFP activity tracking, including project volume, outcomes, and revenue by vendor, for internal reporting. Deliverables & Client Support Produce client-ready Excel workbooks and PowerPoint decks that follow HUB brand standards. Draft executive summaries that translate technical pricing analysis into clear recommendations for HR and finance audiences. Support consultants and account managers in finalist presentations, client meetings, and contract negotiation preparation. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, health administration, pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent experience. At least 2 years of experience in pharmacy analytics , gained at a PBM, health plan, benefits consultancy, pharmacy benefit coalition, or similar organization. Hands-on experience with pharmacy claims data, including NDC-level data, AWP, MAC, dispensing fees, days’ supply, and brand/generic/specialty classifications. Advanced Excel skills, including large datasets, pivot tables, lookups, scenario modeling, and formula auditing. Working knowledge of PBM pricing and contract terminology (AWP discounts, rebate guarantees, spread pricing, pass-through, MAC lists, specialty channel management). Strong attention to detail and data validation before outputs reach account teams Ability to manage several concurrent projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical findings to non-technical audiences. Preferred Qualifications Experience conducting or supporting PBM RFPs, market checks, or claims re-pricing. SQL, Alteryx, Python, R, Power BI, or Tableau experience for larger datasets. Familiarity with ERISA, PBM transparency legislation, and state PBM reform trends. Exposure to clinical programs (utilization management, formulary strategy, specialty management) and their financial impact. Core Competencies Analytical rigor • Accuracy under deadlines • Ownership and follow-through • strong verbal & written communication • Professional skepticism • Collaboration across regions •growth minded •team oriented JOIN OUR TEAM Do you believe in the power of innovation, collaboration, and transformation? Do you thrive in a supportive and client focused work environment? Are you looking for an opportunity to help build and drive change in a rapidly growing and evolving organization? When you join HUB International , you will be part of a community of learners and doers focused on our Core Values: entrepreneurship, teamwork, integrity, accountability, and service. The expected salary range for this position is $80,000 to $95,000 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position’s business line, scope and level. HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include health/dental/vision/life/disability insurance, FSA, HSA and 401(k) accounts, paid-time-off benefits such as vacation, sick, personal, floating holidays and company holidays. In addition, eligible annual bonuses, equity and commissions may be available for some positions. What we offer you We invest in your growth. HUB offers structured training, licensing support , and ongoing development opportunities designed to accelerate your career. Benefits and programs vary based on employment status, role, location, and applicable eligibility requirements. Competitive pay with comprehensive health benefits, retirement savings matching, and company-paid life and disability plans Generous paid time off, paid parental leave and a wellbeing program designed to support real work/life balance A collaborative, high-performing culture with meaningful engagement, community impact through HUB Gives and genuine room to grow your career The HUB difference HUB International is one of North America’s largest insurance brokers, delivering risk management, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management solutions to businesses and individuals across the United States and Canada — through locally led teams backed by national expertise, giving you the agility of a local partner and the reach of a global organization. jobs.title: Data Quality Analyst
jobs.jd: At Aristocrat, we believe in bringing happiness to life through the power of play! As a global leader in gaming content and technology, we are committed to innovation and excellence. Joining our team as a Data Quality Analyst means you will ensure our data’s integrity and accuracy. This role is key to our Master Data Operations team and offers an outstanding chance to influence important business decisions with your analytical insights. If you have a passion for data quality and ambition, this opportunity is ideal for you! What You'll Do Build and maintain data-quality scorecards for customer, product, and installed-base data. Monitor data against defined quality rules and thresholds, and flag issues as they arise. Perform root-cause analysis on recurring data issues and recommend process or system fixes. Prioritize the data-quality issue backlog by business impact, including revenue and reporting impact. Track progress against year-one targets, including the reduction in aged critical issues and manual reconciliation effort. Produce regular reports and dashboards for the team lead and business stakeholders. jobs.title: AI Deployment Analyst
jobs.jd:
AI DEPLOYMENT ANALYST - SILNA


ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for a curious, analytical teammate to join our AI Operations team at Silna https://www.silnahealth.com. In this role, you’ll help us design, test, and roll out AI deployments that interpret complex healthcare documents, like treatment plans and prior authorization approval letters, using optical character recognition (OCR) and agentic AI. You will work on the end-to-end deployment of browser and phone agents for automating healthcare web-based workflows.

This is a great role for a recent graduate with a background in computer science, data science, or a non-technical field who wants to apply those skills in a real-world, high-impact healthcare setting. You’ll work closely with operations and engineering to make sure our AI systems produce accurate, usable outputs that enable patients to access care faster.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Develop, test, and refine AI deployments that extract structured information from healthcare documents (e.g., treatment plans, prior authorization approvals) or web-based authorization and verification workflows. Analyze model outputs for accuracy and identify areas for improvement.

 - Work with operations and engineering teams to translate healthcare and insurance workflows into clear technical specifications for AI.

 - Create documentation and playbooks to ensure prompt strategies are reproducible and scalable.

 - Stay up-to-date with best practices in AI prompting, document parsing, and healthcare data handling.

 - Work cross functionally with our team of healthcare experts to drive the roll out of our automation strategies.

 - Measure and evaluate progress by creating clearly defined metrics.


QUALIFICATIONS

 -  Background in computer science, data science, or non-technical field but with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities (recent graduates encouraged to apply).

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.

 - Interest in natural language processing concepts, AI/ML, or OCR technologies (coursework or internship experience counts!).

 - Ability to think critically about ambiguous problems and propose structured solutions.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - Bonus: Experience with Python, SQL, or healthcare data/insurance workflows.




ABOUT SILNA

Healthcare is obsessed with optimizing a broken system. We're making sure it never breaks.

Silna Health attacks the root cause of denied claims: the fragmented, incompatible systems that govern prior authorizations, eligibility verification, and benefit checks, turning workflows that used to take days into decisions made in minutes, before care is ever delivered.

We work across behavioral health, physical health, ambulatory care, and post-acute care, where administrative failure doesn't just cost money; it can delay or deny patient access entirely. We're backed by Accel and Bain Capital Ventures, and we're building fast.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - A fast-paced work environment with an incredibly enthusiastic and motivated team

 - The opportunity to work with customers that really love the product

 - Competitive compensation and benefits package

 - 401k

jobs.title: (US) Deal Desk Analyst
jobs.jd:
The Deal Desk is a centralized, corporate Revenue Operations function responsible for governing non-standard, high-value commercial deals across PointClickCare. The team partners closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Executive Leadership to ensure pricing, billing, and contractual decisions balance customer flexibility with disciplined financial standards. This role operates as an individual contributor within the Deal Desk, supporting strategic deal reviews and serving as a trusted advisor on complex commercial structures. The Analyst plays a critical role in enabling deal velocity while maintaining consistency, transparency, and governance.  
 
The Deal Desk Analyst supports PointClickCare's Deal Desk by managing the intake, review, and tracking of concession and pricing exception requests. The role ensures every request is accurate, complete, and backed by clear analysis before it reaches approvers, and that decisions are documented and reported consistently. Working under the direction of the Manager, Deal Desk, the Analyst builds pricing workbooks and proposals, maintains Deal Desk data across systems, and produces monthly reporting on concession activity, providing data-driven insights that inform pricing, billing, and contract decisions. This position suits someone with strong Excel and analytical skills, high attention to detail, and an interest in growing into more complex deal structuring work. 
 
Key Responsibilities
Deal Desk Request Intake & Review
Serve as a point of contact for concession and pricing exception requests
Validate request details against internal systems and assess the risks and tradeoffs of each requested concession
Classify each request against the Deal Desk request taxonomy, confirm required approvals, and route to the appropriate approvers
Document decisions, approvals, and rationale so every request has a clear audit trail
Pricing & Deal Analysis
Build pricing models, billing ramps, and revenue forecasts using current pricing and packaging guidelines
Support financial and commercial analysis for non-standard and high-value deals, including the impact of discounts and term changes on MRR and overall deal economics
Convert internal pricing into clean, customer-facing proposals that meet PointClickCare standards
Deal Desk Data, Tracking & Reporting
Maintain Deal Desk approval tracking so reporting stays accurate
Run regular data quality checks and resolve discrepancies across systems and teams
Support monthly Deal Desk reporting on request volume, concession types, approval outcomes, win/loss trends, and more
Sales Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Answer rep questions on pricing mechanics, approval requirements, and the Deal Desk intake process
Partner with cross-functional teams to confirm approved terms are set up correctly and accurately reflected in contracts and quotes
Partner with the Manager and fellow Deal Desk Analysts to share knowledge, align on request reviews, and apply standards consistently
Process Improvement & Automation
Help document Deal Desk processes, approval criteria, and the request taxonomy
Identify recurring request patterns and suggest improvements to pricing guidelines and Deal Desk policies
Build and maintain templates, tools, and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual work and improve turnaround time
Qualifications & Skills
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, analytics, or a related field
1–3 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, pricing, finance, or a related analytical role
Strong Excel skills (formulas, lookups, pivot tables) and the ability to build basic pricing and financial models
High attention to detail and comfort working with data across multiple systems
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize analysis for Sales and leadership audiences
Ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce
Familiarity with SaaS pricing, discounting, quote-to-cash processes, billing models, and contract structures
Experience using AI tools or automation to streamline analysis and reporting
SaaS and/or healthcare industry experience

jobs.jd: At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. Job Description We are looking for someone who is curious, motivated to learn, and brings a positive, collaborative attitude to our Wholesale and Small Business Model Validation team. The role sits within the Model Risk Management department, part of the Risk Management and Compliance organization at U.S. Bank. As a Quantitative Model Validation Analyst, you will support the independent validation of CCAR and CECL credit loss forecasting models and risk rating scorecard models across commercial portfolios. These models are foundational to enterprise credit risk assessment, loss forecasting, reserving, and capital planning, offering a unique opportunity to deliver high-impact insights through rigorous analysis, clear documentation, and strong stakeholder engagement. Key Responsibilities: Conduct independent validation of the Bank’s wholesale and small business portfolio credit loss forecasting models supporting CCAR stress testing and CECL requirements. Evaluate model conceptual soundness, the reasonableness of assumptions, the reliability of data, the appropriateness of performance metrics, the effectiveness of model monitoring, and the adequacy of implementation testing. Design and execute validation testing, including benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, and outcome analysis, to assess model limitations, uncertainty, assumption risk, and forecast reasonableness. Identify emerging risks and assess the impact of evolving market conditions on model performance, conducting research to evaluate potential model degradation and associated model risk. Document and communicate validation outcomes and findings, ensuring model risks are accurately identified, timely escalated, and clearly understood by stakeholders and regulators. Support departmental initiatives to enhance validation practices, streamline validation processes, and leverage advanced tools and technologies to improve efficiency and effectiveness. jobs.title: Data Scientist 3
jobs.jd: Data Scientist 3 As our Data Scientist 3, you will handle multiple projects at once and act as an internal business consultant to help optimize every facet of this organization. You will solve problems and answer questions – using data – for other departments to help us reduce costs, reduce errors, and be a better organization for our 17 million members. Note: This is a hybrid role; the candidate must reside within a 100-mile radius of our Costa Mesa CA office and be available to work on-site 3 days a week on a regular basis, as well as 2–3 times per month for team meetings and collaboration days. What You’ll Do Will understand how the specific task fits into the bigger picture and suggest how to best accomplish it within the project framework. Will self-manage tasks and projects and complete them on time and under general supervision. Every day, you will help solve business problems presented to us by stakeholders using data. You will get a scenario or problem, such as, “We need to reduce cycle times,” and then pull, analyze, and interpret data relevant to that scenario. You will pull data from SQL databases. You will analyze and interpret data using Python, R, or other tools. You will determine patterns or trends and their statistical significance to the problem. To visualize the data, you will use Tableau. Once you have done your analysis, paired with a data engineer, you will present your findings to the stakeholder and confirm, refute or simply acknowledge a hypothesis. Your work may be implemented or may develop into something else. What You’ll Need To thrive in this role, you must have a solid foundation of statistics and data analysis. You must be able to describe a project where you pulled data, analyzed it, identified trends or patterns, determined significance, and delivered insights or recommendations to the business. What was your approach? What tools did you use and why? Did you get to the root cause of the issue? Did you confirm or refute a hypothesis? You must be able to speak to your involvement and decisions at each stage. For pulling data, we use SQL so you must be proficient with this tool. To curate and analyze data, we use a variety of languages and programs: Python, R, and even Excel. You can choose whatever tool helps you best, but you must be proficient in either Python or R. Excellent communication skills and an attitude of flexibility are a must. Very often, we get into the data and some aspect takes longer than we thought, or we have to pivot and change how we approach a problem. A dashboard works better than a model, perhaps. Then you have to explain to the stakeholder or the team why you made that change or why the deliverable is taking longer than expected. It’s all about being creative in your approach and communicating that frequently and clearly to people who may be less tech or data-savvy than you. #LI-SH1 Remarkable benefits: • Health coverage for medical, dental, vision • 401(K) saving plans with company match AND Pension • Tuition assistance • Floating holidays and PTO for community volunteer programs • Paid parental leave • Wellness programs • Employee discounts (membership, insurance, travel, entertainment, services and more!) Auto Club Enterprises is the largest club within the national AAA federation. We have nearly 17,000 employees in 24 states helping more than 18 million members. The strength of our organization is our employees. Bringing together and supporting different cultures, backgrounds, personalities, and strengths creates a team capable of delivering legendary, lifetime service to our members. When we embrace our diversity – we win. All of Us! With our national brand recognition, long-standing reputation since 1900, and constantly growing membership, we are seeking career-minded, service-driven professionals to join our team. "Through dedicated employees we proudly deliver legendary service and beneficial products that provide members peace of mind and value.” AAA is an Equal Opportunity Employer Our organization participates in E-Verify
