jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.jd:
Ready to turn sales data into decisions for some of the world’s fastest-growing consumer brands? Join ZURU as a Business Analyst.



Who We Are

ZURU is a reimagination company. We look for categories that have stood still, then we build next-generation products and brands that set the new standard. ZURU Toys is reimagining play. ZURU Edge is reinventing everyday consumer brands. Rhodes Pet Science is reimagining pet science. ZURU Tech is leading the next building revolution.

ZURU started in 2003 with two brothers from New Zealand, and we’re still founder-owned and operated today. Since then we’ve become the world’s second-biggest privately held toy company, and nearly half of all Gen Y and Gen Z households with kids in the US own a ZURU product. Today we’re 5,000 people in 34 offices, selling into more than 150 markets, backed by over 100 acres of fully automated manufacturing. And we’re only getting started.



The Opportunity

ZURU is growing fast, and our Sales team is looking for a Business Analyst who loves numbers and the story behind them. You’ll work across consumer brands like MONDAY Haircare, DAISE, Millie Moon and Rascals + Friends, and toy brands like X-Shot, Bunch of Balloons and Mini Brands, while helping launch new brands to market. You’ll be the analytical engine behind our Key Account team, turning data into decisions and helping shape what ends up on shelf.



The Impact You’ll Make

This is a critical seat at the heart of our commercial team. You’ll be the single source of truth for sales performance across your portfolio, so when the team walks into a retailer meeting, your numbers and insights are what they lean on. You’ll own trade performance reporting, help win range reviews with major retailers and show which promotions actually paid off. Along the way you’ll work with Sales, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain, building the commercial grounding that sets you up for a big career in consumer goods.



What You’ll Do

 - Own weekly, monthly and ad-hoc sales reporting across our key retail customers

 - Build and maintain dashboards that track sell-out, distribution, share of shelf and promotional uplift

 - Track sales against targets, spot risks and opportunities early, and share what you find with the commercial team

 - Measure how promotions performed: work out the return on each one and compare it to forecast and last year

 - Build customer-ready category and brand presentations for range reviews and new listings, using scan data from Quantium, NielsenIQ and Circana

 - Track which products are gaining or losing distribution, and recommend what to do about lines at risk

 - Support new product launches by modelling sales, tracking sell-in and reporting on early sell-out

 - Work with Marketing, Supply Chain and Finance on promo calendars, stock availability, trade spend and monthly commentary



What You’ll Bring

 - Confidence in Excel and PowerPoint: formulas, PivotTables and clean, insight-led slides (we’ll help you sharpen the advanced stuff)

 - A curious, commercial mindset: when you see a number, you want to know the story behind it

 - Sharp attention to detail: you can juggle several deadlines without letting accuracy slip

 - Clear communication: you can explain data simply to people who aren’t analysts

 - A real interest in FMCG, retail or consumer data: no direct experience required



Think you’ve got what it takes? Apply now and tell us your story.





Who thrives at ZURU

This isn’t a 9-to-5. We move fast, think big and set goals most companies would call impossible, then go after them. The people who thrive here are entrepreneurs at heart. They own their work, chase bold ideas and never stop raising the bar.

At ZURU, you drive your career, and we give you the platform to take it as far as you can. There are opportunities here that you won’t find anywhere else, and you’ll be surrounded by talented people who make things happen. We’re a true meritocracy: we reward impact, not tenure.



How we work

Big ideas happen when great people work side by side, so we’re office-first by design. Being together means faster collaboration, sharper decisions and stronger teams, and it’s where the real learning happens. Some flexibility may be available depending on the role, location and business needs, but most roles are office-based.



Want to see what life at ZURU really looks like? Follow @LifeatZURU on Instagram or visit www.zuru.com http://www.zuru.com.



ZURU – Reimagining tomorrow 🚀

jobs.title: Supply Chain Analyst
jobs.jd: About the Company General Matter is enriching uranium in America. Our goal is to design, build, and operate the world’s lowest-cost enrichment services in the United States. Our mission is to restore America’s ability to produce nuclear fuel—fuel that will power AI, advanced manufacturing, critical industries, and the next generation of nuclear reactors. Ultimately, our work will help power national ambitions and enable a high-energy society. We were incubated by Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by top-tier investors. Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production. We are a mission-driven company with a culture of urgency, accountability, and transparency. Help us build a high-energy society by making the cleanest, safest form of baseload energy the most affordable. About This Role General Matter is building the supply chain that will put American-enriched uranium back into production, and we are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to keep our teams supplied with everything they need to build. In this role you will support the full range of supply chain functions—purchasing, vendor management, inventory, and data—working shoulder to shoulder with the engineers and operators building mission-critical hardware. You will own problems end to end, from sourcing a custom component to cleaning up the data that tells us what to buy and when. You will primarily operate for a functional area in the business: Software + I&C, Engineering, or Operations. The analyst role works directly with the engineers and operators to turn requirements into orders, ensure all needs are met, and maintain the organizational supply chain. Responsibilities Support procurement and purchasing of components, raw materials, and services for the departments you support, from requisition through delivery. Manage vendor and supplier relationships day to day—placing and expediting orders, tracking performance, and resolving supply issues before they slow the team down. Own category and vendor management for assigned commodities, including qualifying suppliers and negotiating for price, lead time, and availability. Track inventory, demand, and shortages, and give engineering and manufacturing clear visibility into what is clear-to-build. Maintain accurate master data in our ERP/MRP systems and build the reports and analysis the team needs to make fast, informed decisions. Build reports, dashboards, and cost models that drive decisions to capture and communicate the status of the supply chain program. Partner cross-functionally with engineers, operators, and other supply chain team members to identify problems and drive them to resolution with a bias for action. Basic Qualifications Evidence of exceptional ability (prior projects, portfolio of work, completed products, etc). Strong understanding of engineering fundamentals. Ability to perform trade studies and make clear recommendations using first principles and engineering fundamentals even with partial information. Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, Economics, or a related field. 2–3 years of experience in supply chain, procurement, planning, operations, or a related analytical role (internships included). Preferred Skills and Experience Experience in a fast-paced engineering or highly technical environment, with a resourceful approach to delivering under tight timelines or budget constraints. Hands-on experience with an ERP/MRP system (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle). Strong data management and analysis skills, including advanced proficiency in Excel. Exposure to procurement or purchasing processes, including working with suppliers on lead times, MOQs, and price breaks. Experience in a hardware, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or other highly technical environment. SQL, Python, or BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) experience. Experience buying to nuclear or other quality standards (e.g., NQA-1, 10 CFR Part 21, ISO 9001, AS9100). Additional Requirements: Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary. Equal Opportunity Employer General Matter is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with General Matter is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. Compensation and Benefits The base salary range for this role is $100,000–$130,000 annually. Compensation bands are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual level and base pay is determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities and internal equity. Please note that the stated salary range is an estimate and may be adjusted based on market conditions, business needs, or other factors. In addition to base salary, for full-time hires, you may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of stock options, and access to medical, vision & dental coverage as well as access to a 401(k) retirement plan.

jobs.jd: Job Description: WSJ Newsroom | Data Analyst (September 2026) Title: Data Analyst, Newsroom Analytics The Wall Street Journal is seeking a Data Analyst to join our newsroom data team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Newsroom Analytics. You will work alongside our senior analysts to produce the reports, dashboards, and analyses the newsroom relies on to make editorial, audience, and product decisions every day. This role is a chance to build real analytical range in a fast-moving newsroom environment. You will spend most of your time in SQL, pulling data, building and maintaining dashboards, and helping the newsroom get answers quickly. You will use AI tools to accelerate this work, building lightweight utilities and automations that improve efficiency across the team and free up time for deeper analysis. You will collaborate closely with more senior colleagues as you take on progressively more independent work, from ad hoc analyses to experiment analysis and measurement projects. This position will be based in our New York office. You will: Write SQL to answer questions from newsroom editorial, audience, and product partners, translating requests into clean, well-scoped queries and clearly communicated results. Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports that expand self-serve access to newsroom data. Support deep-dive analyses on major news events, high-priority moments, and shifts in performance. Help keep the reporting stack reliable by troubleshooting data quality issues, tracing problems back to their source, and partnering with data engineering to resolve them. Contribute to A/B tests and experiment analysis in partnership with senior analysts, growing into independent experiment ownership over time. Learn the newsroom's taxonomies, instrumentation, and foundational datasets, and help maintain shared documentation and analytical patterns the team pulls from. You have: 1 to 2 years in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, or an equivalent internship and project background. Proficient SQL skills, with experience writing queries against non-trivial datasets. Comfort with a modern BI or dashboarding tool (Looker, Tableau, Mode, or similar). Curiosity and speed in picking up new technical concepts and frameworks, and a track record of getting productive on unfamiliar stacks. Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to explain data clearly to non-technical partners. Care for accuracy and detail in work the newsroom will act on. Standout candidates will have strengths in one or more of the following: Experience with large-scale data warehouses like BigQuery or Snowflake, or with dbt. Familiarity with Python for analysis, data wrangling, or automation, and comfort maintaining code in Git. Exposure to A/B testing and applied statistics. A background or strong interest in journalism, media, or content, and enthusiasm for driving journalistic outcomes. Comfort using AI/LLM tooling to speed up analytical workflows. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Fraud Risk Detection
jobs.jd: Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries. At Experian, we believe great work happens when people come together. We're focused on attracting talent in and around our designated hub locations who are open to collaborating with colleagues in person. Aligning employees to these talent markets helps foster collaboration, strengthen team connections, and support long-term career growth within Experian. This is a hybrid position and you will reside in or near one of our collaboration hubs: Costa Mesa, San Diego & San Jose, CA · Allen & Austin, TX · Franklin, TN · New York, NY · Schaumburg, IL · Washington, DC · Atlanta, GA · Boston, MA · Seattle, WA Overview Experian's Fraud Analytics & Commercialization operates across four main functions. These include client engagement analytics, scalable and custom analytics for financial institutions, fraud analytics consulting, and solution integrity and enablement for production-ready platforms. You will help investigate new fraud patterns, build features, and train and evaluate machine learning models. You will work with senior data scientists and engineers throughout the model development lifecycle, from problem definition and data assembly through feature engineering, experimentation, and deployment. Your work will contribute to the techniques, analytical tools, and capabilities Experian's fraud analytics team has spent years refining. This is an individual contributor position and you will report into the Sr. Manager of Fraud Analytics What you'll do Explore large datasets, with guidance from senior team members, to identify fraud patterns, attack methods, and behavioral signals. Work with senior data scientists to translate fraud questions into testable hypotheses and analytical approaches. Help build machine learning models for fraud detection across account opening, account takeover, and identity risk. Evaluate models using both technical and business metrics, such as precision, recall, fraud capture rate, false-positive rate, and customer friction. Develop and validate features using identity, transactional, behavioral, and other available data sources. Write clean, well-tested code, and work with engineering to bring models and features into production. Partner with the score monitoring team to help set up model and feature monitoring, and support research on related client questions. Help prepare analyses and communicate findings to both technical and nontechnical audiences. Apply Experian's standards for data privacy, model documentation, explainability, validation, and governance. Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, economics, engineering, data science, or another quantitative discipline — or equivalent experience 1+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or advanced analytics Foundation in supervised learning, model evaluation, feature selection, statistical inference, and techniques such as classification and anomaly detection. Proficiency in Python, with the ability to write clean, readable, and well-tested code. Familiarity with common data science and machine-learning tools such as pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn. Coursework, internship, or project experience related to fraud detection, risk modeling, or another adversarial or classification-style problem. Familiarity with PySpark, cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Databricks, and Snowflake, or other large-scale data tools. Exposure to financial services, fintech, payments, or another regulated or fraud-intensive industry, through coursework, internship, or prior work. #LI-Hybrid Benefits/Perks: Great compensation package and bonus plan Core benefits including medical, dental, vision, and matching 401K Flexible work environment, ability to work remote, hybrid or in-office Flexible time off including volunteer time off, vacation, sick and 12-paid holidays Explore all our exciting benefits here: https://yourexperianbenefits.com/cand-index.html Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. jobs.title: PGIM Real Estate – Analyst/Associate, Data Analytics & Governance
jobs.jd: Job Classification: Technology - Data Analytics & Management A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world. We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers! If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. At PGIM, You Can! What you will do PGIM is seeking an Analyst or Associate, Data Analytics & Governance to join our Global Business Enablement team within Real Estate. This role supports two closely connected priorities: delivering trusted data products and analytics that inform decisions across the real estate investment lifecycle, and putting into practice the data governance that keeps that information accurate, well-defined and reusable. Working alongside other team members, business stakeholders, data stewards and Technology partners, the Analyst/Associate will document business requirements, trace data back to its sources, catalog and define data elements, and build, monitor and report on data quality rules. This is a hands-on role for an early-career professional who enjoys getting into the data, wants to understand how a global real estate investment business operates, and is excited to grow in a modern, AI-enabled data environment. This is a hybrid role (on-site 3 times a week) based in Newark, NJ or New York, NY. What you can expect Data Analytics · Participate in requirements gathering sessions with business stakeholders and document the questions, users, definitions, calculations and acceptance criteria for new data products and reports. · Trace the full data lineage for each new data product, mapping every required data element back to its source system, owner and transformations, and documenting gaps, overlaps and conflicting definitions. · Partner with Technology team members to build and maintain analytical datasets and reports using SQL, Power BI / Fabric and Excel, combining data from multiple internal and external sources. · Work directly with source data to validate assumptions, reconcile results across funds, systems and reports, and investigate variances and anomalies. · Support business testing and validation of new data products by preparing test cases, comparing outputs to source and historical data, and logging and tracking issues to resolution. · Help convert recurring ad-hoc requests into reusable datasets and self-service reports, reducing manual effort and one-off spreadsheet builds. · Prepare and normalize data sets for reporting. · Prepare user guides, data dictionaries and training materials that explain what each data product contains and the questions it can answer. · Support AI use cases across the team by documenting requirements, testing AI-generated outputs for accuracy and reasonableness. Data Governance · Catalog data elements in the firm's data catalog tool (e.g., Microsoft Purview), capturing business definitions, owners, source systems, classifications and lineage. · Maintain the business glossary to keep terminology, calculations and definitions consistent across teams and regions. · Partner with data stewards and subject-matter experts to establish data quality rules (e.g., completeness, validity, consistency, timeliness and accuracy) and encode them as automated, repeatable checks. · Monitor data quality and produce regular data quality metrics, scorecards and trend reporting for stakeholders and governance forums. · Perform root cause analysis of data quality issues, tracing them back to their source, and refer them to the appropriate data stewards for remediation; track issues through to resolution and confirm fixes are made at the source rather than in downstream reports. · Support governance processes, including change management for definitions and datasets, data access requests and the appropriate handling of sensitive data. What you will bring · Bachelor's degree in information systems, finance, economics, real estate, data/analytics or a related field. · 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis, data governance, data quality or reporting, ideally in commercial real estate, investment/asset management or financial services. · Working proficiency in SQL and advanced Excel; hands-on experience with Power BI or a similar BI tool (Microsoft Fabric a plus) and with semantic models. · Familiarity with data governance concepts, including data catalogs, business glossaries, data lineage, data quality rules and metrics, master data management; experience with Microsoft Purview, Ataccama or similar tools is a plus. · Ability to write clear, well-structured documentation, including business requirements, data definitions, lineage maps and test results. · Comfort working with large, imperfect datasets and reconciling data across multiple systems. · Strong attention to detail, with the instinct to dig into a number that looks wrong and the persistence to find out why. · Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both business and technical colleagues. · Genuine enthusiasm for AI and emerging technologies, demonstrated by hands-on use of current tools and ongoing self-directed learning. · Interest in commercial real estate and investment management; prior exposure is a plus. · A collaborative, curious and organized approach, with an eagerness to learn and grow. *PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply. Note : Prudential is required by state specific laws to include the salary range for this role when hiring a resident in applicable locations. The salary range for this role is from $90,000 to $130,000. Specific pricing for the role may vary within the above range based on many factors including geographic location, candidate experience, and skills. Roles may also be eligible for additional compensation and/or benefits. About PGIM Real Estate With $207.9 billion in gross assets under management and administration ($133.8 billion net),1 PGIM Real Estate provides investors and borrowers access to a range of real estate equity, real estate debt, agriculture, and impact solutions across the risk-return spectrum. PGIM Real Estate is a business of PGIM, the global asset management business of Prudential Financial, Inc. ( NYSE: PRU ). PGIM Real Estate’s risk management approach, execution capabilities and industry insights are backed by a 50-year legacy of investing in commercial real estate, a 140-year history of real estate financing,2 and the local experience of professionals in 32 cities globally. Through its investment, financing, asset management, and talent management approach, PGIM Real Estate engages in practices that strive to ignite positive environmental and social impact, while pursuing activities that seek to strengthen communities around the world. For more information visit pgimrealestate.com . What we offer you: Market competitive base salaries, with a yearly bonus potential at every level. Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, Paid Time Off (PTO), and leave of absences, such as parental and military leave. 401(k) plan with company match (up to 4%). Company-funded pension plan. Wellness Programs including up to $1,600 a year for reimbursement of items purchased to support personal wellbeing needs. Work/Life Resources to help support topics such as parenting, housing, senior care, finances, pets, legal matter

ABOUT POSTHOG

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

 - A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking

 - PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

 - Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

 1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

 2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 

 


THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

 - Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.


JOB SUMMARY

Help us understand how PostHog grows, what that growth costs, and what we should plan for next. Working directly with our Finance team, you’ll own the day-to-day consolidated financial model, expense planning, and board reporting, with their guidance. You’ll explain differences between actual results and plans, partner with team leads on hiring and spending decisions, and ask thoughtful questions that challenge our assumptions.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Corporate planning and consolidation
   
   - Maintain the integrated three-statement forecast: income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow. Keep actuals, assumptions, and scenarios consistent and easy to follow.
   
   - Own the quarterly board pack and investor reporting. Report costs versus plan each month and explain what changed. Support fundraising analysis when needed.

 - Operating expenses and business partnering
   
   - Work with team leads to track hiring and vendor spending. Update the forecast each month and explain changes.
   
   - Set up monthly planning reviews so team leads can see their spending outlook and discuss changes.

 - Revenue and commercial analysis
   
   - Support Mine's revenue modeling, check inputs and calculations, document assumptions, and explain performance versus plan.
   
   - Run the weekly revenue update when Mine is out.

 - Example public issues/projects:
   The models and board materials are internal. These links provide public context for example projects.
   
   - Build a consolidated forecast and monthly reporting pack. Public context: Finance team https://posthog.com/teams/finance
   
   - Build a headcount and vendor-spend forecast that shows what changed each month and which decisions need review. Public context: Spending money https://posthog.com/handbook/people/spending-money
   
   - Build an infrastructure cost forecast and show how cost per product changes as usage grows. Public context: Pricing and usage-based products https://posthog.com/pricing




WHAT YOU WON'T BE DOING

❌ Sales Ops execution (deal desk, contracts, credits/refunds, commission calculations, policy implementation)

❌ Accounting close, revenue recognition, collections, and the GL

❌ Billing-system engineering or ownership of the data platform. The analyst uses and checks these teams' outputs for planning.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 - Build and debug an integrated three-statement model in Excel or Google Sheets. Make assumptions explicit, add checks, and test scenarios.

 - Turn an unclear business question into a model. Separate facts from assumptions and explain which inputs drive the answer.

 - Reconcile model outputs to source data and investigate discrepancies. Keep forecasts and reporting accurate and up to date.

 - Explain why results differ from plan, get useful inputs from team leads, and follow up on missing information.

 - Ask questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and want to learn how a software business works.

 - AI is part of how you work. You use tools to build and check models, write SQL, and automate reporting, and you can show us examples of this.

 - Work in a small team where processes are still being built.

jobs.jd: Who We Are: Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be. Seek Excellence. Be Selective To Be Effective. Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled. Disagree Transparently. Encourage Independent Decision-Making. Build Dream Teams. Who You Are: Working as the Capex FP&A Associate on the Data Center Finance team, you will own the financial side of Galaxy’s data center construction program: building and maintaining construction budgets, cost-to-complete forecasts, and capital cash flow models that support project financing, equity funding, and executive decision-making. You will be the liaison between Construction, Procurement, Accounting, and Treasury, maintaining a single, reliable view of the budget, commitments, actuals, forecasts, and funding for every project from award through closeout. You should be able to conceptualize the “big picture” and translate concepts into detailed tactical execution plans while maintaining a high degree of accuracy. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities, and demonstrating the grit and ownership required to deliver accurate, timely insights. What You’ll Do: Develop a deep understanding of Galaxy’s growing data center business, including project phases, construction delivery structures, and how capital flows from budget to contract to cash. Partner with Procurement and the construction team to build, model and maintain construction budgets and cost-to-complete forecasts by project and phase, tracking committed, incurred, and paid costs against budget and flagging variances early. Analyze construction and vendor contracts (including GMPs, purchase orders, and change orders) to determine committed scope, exclusions, contingency, and the remaining purchases still to come. Track and reconcile POs, change orders, and pay applications across vendors, ensuring budget, contract, and invoice records are tied out. Develop quarterly and rolling 12-month capital cash flow forecasts, including vendor payments, deposits, retainage, and funding timing, and clearly show funded versus unfunded needs. Support project financing reporting, including draw packages and funded-versus-unfunded schedules, reconciliation of project budgets to lender and investor models, and lender reporting requirements. Partner with Accounting on month- and quarter-end close, including accrual support for work in place not yet invoiced, capitalization of project costs, and reconciliation of the capital budget and forecast to construction-in-progress (CIP) balances. Collaborate cross-functionally with business leaders and partner closely with Construction, Procurement, and the broader Finance organization, including Group FP&A, Accounting, and Treasury. Create dashboards and KPIs, covering budget versus actual, committed versus uncommitted spend, contingency usage, cost per MW, and funding status for executive and lender audiences. Maintain documentation of financial processes and procedures to ensure compliance and efficiency, including controls over the capital budget and forecast process, and respond to audit requests related to capital projects. Provide data-driven ad-hoc analysis to support executive and business specific reporting. Embrace and champion the thoughtful adoption of AI to improve team performance and business outcomes. able to explain financial concepts clearly to construction and executive audiences Bonus Points: Experience with Workday or FP&A planning platforms (e.g., Adaptive Planning) Familiarity with construction contract structures and documents (AIA forms, GMP, EPC, schedule of values, pay applications, retainage) Familiarity with project cost accounting concepts such as commitments, estimate at completion (EAC), capitalization, and construction-in-progress (CIP) or WIP reporting Experience supporting construction loan, project financing, or lender draw processes Experience working at a high growth company An understanding of VBA, AI-assisted analytical tools, Power BI, Python, or SQL What We Offer: Competitive base salary and discretionary bonus Hybrid/Flexible Working Arrangements Flexible Time Off (paid) 3% 401(k) company contribution Company-paid health and protective benefits for employees, partners, and other dependents Generous paid Parental Leave Competitive family planning benefits for US employees Opportunities to learn about the Crypto industry Smart, entrepreneurial, and fun colleagues Free daily snacks and weekly breakfasts/lunches Employee Resource Groups Free coaching and counseling sessions through Headspace Apply now and join us as we grow the economy that runs on code. jobs.title: The North Face: Analyst, Loyalty and CRM - Americas
jobs.location: USCA > USA > Colorado > Denver HQ - VFC
jobs.jd: Join The North Face Family The North Face was built on a love for the outdoors and the desire to enable all types of exploration, for all people, from their backyards to the Himalayas. Over the last 50 years we've lived by our “true north,” the belief that exploration has the power to change us, to challenge us and to help us see the world from new perspectives. To help ignite a global movement of outdoor exploration, love for the natural world and an unwavering commitment to protect it, we welcome and encourage new participants to the outdoors. We extend our reach through support of non-profit organizations, establishing programs that connect participants with close-to-home recreation opportunities, and creating a connection with young leaders, inspiring them to explore and conserve. As we enter our sixth decade, we pledge to: Empower exploration and the thrill of the unknown for as many people as possible. Protect the places where we live, play, and operate. Evolve the way we make our products by improving our environmental performance and social responsibility in the supply chain. The North Face: Analyst, Loyalty & CRM - Americas How You Will Make a Difference The Analyst of Loyalty & CRM is a key member of The North Face Americas Loyalty & Lifecycle team, responsible for the strategy, measurement, and optimization of analytics across XPLR Pass and Lifecycle Marketing channels, including Email, SMS, and Push. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing, this role analyzes customer behavior across loyalty and lifecycle marketing, identifies growth opportunities, and leads measurement and reporting across the program and marketing channels. Working cross-functionally across Loyalty & CRM, Marketing, Ecommerce, Retail, Finance, and Data & Analytics, this role helps improve how performance is measured, insights are communicated, and customer growth opportunities are prioritized. You will play a critical role in driving optimization efforts that deliver real revenue impact across the business and improve member acquisition, engagement and retention. What you will do: Loyalty & CRM Analytics Strategy & Execution: Build and lead the analytics roadmap for Loyalty and Lifecycle Marketing, prioritizing initiatives based on business impact, customer value, feasibility, and strategic objectives. Serve as the primary analytics voice representing loyalty and lifecycle marketing analytics, shaping decisions with objective insights and clear recommendations. Support the execution of omnichannel customer journeys across email, SMS, push notifications, direct mail, and emerging channels through customer data and insights. Partner with CDP, Analytics, and Technology teams to leverage customer data for analysis, audience insights, measurement, and personalization opportunities. Analyze member acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifetime value trends to identify opportunities for incremental growth. Develop forecasts, business cases, and opportunity sizing analyses to support investment decisions and prioritize growth initiatives. Evaluate audience strategies and customer segments to determine effectiveness and inform targeting approaches across lifecycle channels. Lifecycle Measurement & Experimentation Own measurement and performance management across Loyalty and Lifecycle Marketing, including KPI frameworks, dashboards, recurring reporting, executive readouts, and business reviews. Monitor performance trends across loyalty and lifecycle channels, delivering actionable insights into what is happening, why it is happening, and where to act. Establish and maintain KPIs, metric definitions, and measurement standards to ensure consistent reporting across teams and platforms. Lead experimentation strategy, including test design, governance, incrementality, uplift measurement, attribution, and performance evaluation. Quantify incremental revenue impact from lifecycle marketing and loyalty initiatives through testing, attribution, and advanced measurement methodologies. Analyze customer behavior across retail, eCommerce, loyalty, and marketing touch points to deliver a unified view of customer engagement and value. Operating Model Collaborate cross-functionally across the eCommerce team, VF data & analytics team, and marketing teams. Partner with Analytics, Data Engineering, and Technology teams to validate data quality, troubleshoot issues, and ensure accurate reporting. Adhere to a high standard for analytical quality, experimentation rigor, stakeholder engagement, and insight communication. Improve analytics efficiency and quality through automation, modern tools, and AI-enabled capabilities. How you will do it: Leverage analytics, behavioral, and customer data platforms (e.g., GA4, Quantum Metric, Consumer Data Platform- BlueConic, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) to develop a deep understanding of customer behavior and performance Experience using SQL to query, analyze, and validate customer and marketing data. Apply a structured approach to analysis—connecting data → insight → opportunity → recommended action Incorporate segment-level analysis into all work, ensuring recommendations consider how different audiences interact with our marketing channels or loyalty program Maintain strong data quality and consistency by ensuring accurate tracking, KPI definitions, and reporting standards What success looks like: Clear visibility into loyalty and lifecycle marketing performance, with actionable recommendations that drive continuous improvement. Present findings and data-informed recommendations to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership, translating complex analysis into clear business decisions. Consistent delivery of insights that influence business decisions and optimization efforts. High-quality, trusted reporting that enables fast, data-driven decision-making Positive feedback from cross-functional partners on clarity, quality, and usefulness of insights Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity As a purpose-led, performance driven company, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness, and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day. Skills for Success 4+ years in digital analytics, Loyalty analytics, Lifecycle marketing analytics, consumer data platforms, marketing analytics, or related fields Educational Position Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in business, statistics, analytics, mathematics or equivalent professional experience in a digital analytics role. What we expect you already know: Strong foundation in digital analytics tools (e.g., GA4, Tableau, Power BI, Quantum Metrics, Databricks) Strong foundation working with a Consumer Data Platform (e.g. Blueconic) Understanding of Loyalty and Lifecycle Marketing KPIs and metrics (Cost per acquisition, CLV, opens, unique clicks, CTR, CVR, etc.) Understanding of how loyalty program economy works (points, rewards, point liability, breakage, etc.) Experience analyzing customer behavior, journeys, and performance trends Ability to translate data into clear insights and structured outputs Highly proficient in Excel (or similar tools) and experience working with dashboards or reporting tools Basic understanding of customer segmentation concepts (e.g., lifecycle stages, cohort analysis, audience targeting) Experience with forecasting, opportunity sizing, statistical analysis, and measurement methodologies. Location requirement: Denver, Colorado What we will teach you : VF’s systems, tools, and reporting infrastructure· The North Face seasonal strategy and go-to-market calendar· All about our XPLR Pass loyalty program and lifecycle marketing strategy· Internal operating rhythms and cross-functional workflows VF Guiding Principles : Live with Integrity, Act Courageously, Be Curious, Act with Empathy, and Persevere. About us:

Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

 

Why we exist:

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

 

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

 

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).



Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it  —  someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years. 

 

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Data Science team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

 - Growth Marketing 

 - Product Development

 - Strategic Partnerships 

 

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.



Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

 - No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc. 

 - No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals. 

 - Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end. 



What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

 - Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

 - Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

 - Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

 

Who You Are

 - First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?" 

 - Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

 - Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

 

What You'll Bring

 - 2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

 - Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

 - Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

 - Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

 

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

 
 

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

jobs.title: Customer Data Analyst
jobs.jd:
ABOUT US

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners specifically within cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audit. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Fieldguide is looking for a Customer Data Operations Analyst to help build and operationalize the data foundation that connects how customers use Fieldguide with how we measure, understand, and communicate the value they receive from the platform.

This role will sit at the intersection of Customer Success, Product, Data Science, and GTM Operations, translating real-world customer needs into scalable data models, trusted reporting, and actionable insights. The role will combine strong SQL and analytics capabilities with hands-on data modeling and reporting, ensuring customer data is accurate, accessible, and built to scale.

While this role will participate in select customer meetings, QBRs, and onsite engagements to understand reporting requirements firsthand, the majority of the role will be hands-on—developing and customizing reports, querying and validating data, building and maintaining data models, and addressing gaps in the underlying data infrastructure. You will then partner with Product and Data Science to ensure the right information is captured, structured, validated, and surfaced consistently.

The goal is to create a trusted customer data foundation that enables Fieldguide and its customers to answer critical questions around product adoption, engagement, efficiency, time savings, ROI, value realization, and business outcomes.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN


CUSTOMER DATA REPORTING & INSIGHTS

 - Own the development and customization of customer-facing reports and dashboards, translating customer requirements into accurate and actionable reporting.

 - Use SQL and existing data infrastructure to investigate customer questions, validate reported metrics, and resolve discrepancies.

 - Build scalable reporting solutions that can be reused across customers, service lines, and engagement types.

 - Partner with Customer Success to support data-driven QBRs, executive business reviews, renewals, and value realization conversations.

 - Identify where customer-specific reporting requests reveal broader gaps in Fieldguide's underlying data models or product reporting capabilities.

 - Work with Product and Data Science to move frequently requested reporting from manual/custom analysis toward standardized and productized capabilities


DATA MODELING & ANALYTICS

 - Develop and maintain scalable data models that support customer reporting, QBRs, value realization, and product analytics.

 - Write advanced SQL to extract, transform, validate, and analyze customer and product data across multiple data sources.

 - Build and maintain data models and transformations to create reliable, reusable downstream datasets.

 - Identify gaps in existing data models and address legacy data quality, modeling, and structural issues that impact reporting accuracy.

 - Translate recurring one-off reporting requirements into standardized, scalable data models and reporting infrastructure.

 - Partner with Data Science and Data Engineering to determine when customer reporting requirements should be addressed through analytics, data modeling, upstream product instrumentation, or broader infrastructure changes.

 - Establish reusable datasets and semantic definitions that enable consistent reporting across customers rather than recreating logic for individual accounts.

 - Reduce manual and one-off reporting by identifying opportunities for automation and standardized reporting.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role means Fieldguide has a trusted, scalable customer data foundation rather than relying on fragmented or one-off analysis.

 - Customer-facing metrics have clear definitions, sources, methodologies, and owners.

 - Customer teams can confidently use data in QBRs and executive conversations.

 - Product usage and customer outcomes can be connected to measurable value.

 - Data discrepancies are identified and addressed at their source.

 - Customer feedback systematically informs Product and Data priorities.

 - Recurring customer data requests become standardized and automated where possible.

 - Fieldguide can increasingly demonstrate defensible ROI and value realization.

 - Customer reporting becomes consistent across QBRs, renewals, and strategic engagements.

 - Product and Data teams have a clear understanding of the information customers need from Fieldguide.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Operations, Business Intelligence, Customer Analytics, or a related technical data role.

 - Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated experience querying, transforming, validating, and troubleshooting complex datasets.

 - Strong understanding of dimensional data modeling, data transformations, metric definitions, and analytics architecture.

 - Strong understanding of data quality, validation, governance, and operational workflows.

 - Ability to translate business and customer questions into structured data requirements.

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort working with large or complex datasets.

 - Experience creating dashboards, reports, and executive-level data narratives.

 - Excellent communication skills, particularly the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at a B2B SaaS or enterprise software company.

 - Hands-on experience with dbt, including building, maintaining, testing, and documenting scalable data models.

 - Experience supporting Customer Success, QBRs, value realization, or customer analytics.

 - Familiarity with audit, advisory, accounting, or professional services workflows.

 - Experience working with product telemetry and customer usage data.

 - Experience partnering directly with Data Science or Analytics Engineering teams.



More about Fieldguide:

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

 - Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

 - Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

 - Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

 - Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

 - Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

 - Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.

Some of our benefits include:

 - Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

 - Flexible PTO

 - 401k

 - Wellness benefits

 - Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

 - Flexible work schedules

jobs.jd: Financial Analysts ensure that Google makes sound financial decisions. As a Financial Analyst, your work, whether it's modeling business scenarios or tracking performance metrics, is used by our leaders to make strategic company decisions. Working on multiple projects at a time, you are focused on the details while finding creative ways to take on big picture challenges. As someone who knows the workings of the core Finance team inside and out, you'll lead individual projects to transform planning, tracking and control processes. You'll provide senior level management with insightful recommendations, planning and reporting support. In this role, you will work day-to-day with Android business leaders to construct multi-year commercial agreements with some of Android's largest global partners. The name Google came from "googol," a mathematical term for the number 1 followed by 100 zeros. And nobody at Google loves big numbers like the Finance team when providing in depth analysis on all manner of strategic decisions across Google products. From developing forward-thinking analysis to generating management reports to scaling our automated financial processes, the Finance organization is an important partner and advisor to the business. Forecast partner-level profit and loss statements (P&Ls) and report back on variances, both in close cycles and at Vice President-plus (VP+) level agreement performance assessment forums alongside Business Development (BD). Build easy-to-understand financial models and dynamic dashboards using artificial intelligence (AI) and Google tools, commanding large datasets across cross-functional stakeholders to track key metrics, visualize trends, and provide actionable business insights. Exceptional communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives tailored for executive leadership and business-facing stakeholders. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Preparedness
jobs.jd:
About the Team

The Preparedness team is an important part of the Safety Systems https://openai.com/safety/safety-systems org at OpenAI, and is guided by OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework https://openai.com/index/updating-our-preparedness-framework/.

Frontier AI models have the potential to benefit all of humanity, but also pose increasingly severe risks. To ensure that AI promotes positive change, the Preparedness team helps us prepare for the development of increasingly capable frontier AI models. This team is tasked with identifying, tracking, and preparing for catastrophic risks related to frontier AI models.

The mission of the Preparedness team is to:

 1. Closely monitor and predict the evolving capabilities of frontier AI systems, with an eye towards misuse risks whose impact could be catastrophic to our society

 2. Ensure we have concrete procedures, infrastructure and partnerships to mitigate these risks and to safely handle the development of powerful AI systems

Preparedness tightly connects capability assessment, evaluations, and internal red teaming, and mitigations for frontier models, as well as overall coordination on AGI preparedness. This is fast paced, exciting work that has far reaching importance for the company and for society.

 

About the Role

We’re hiring a Data Scientist to help build, evaluate, and continuously improve mitigations that prevent extreme harms from AI systems. This role is for an experienced, highly autonomous individual contributor who can take ambiguous problem statements, structure rigorous analyses, and translate findings into actionable product and policy changes.

This position goes beyond “running evals.” You’ll help create mitigation intelligence and monitoring systems that enable OpenAI to detect issues early, measure effectiveness over time, and reduce both over-blocking (unnecessary friction) and under-blocking (missed harm).





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Evaluate and improve mitigation systems, including classifiers and detection pipelines across domains (e.g., biosecurity, cybersecurity, and emerging risk areas).

 - Diagnose false positives and false negatives with deep error analysis, root cause investigation, and clear recommendations for mitigation adjustments.

 - Build monitoring and measurement frameworks to track mitigation effectiveness over time and across user segments and use cases.

 - Identify trends in over-blocking vs. under-blocking, quantify customer impact, and propose prioritized interventions.

 - Develop insights from customer feedback, complaints, and usage patterns to detect shifts in adversarial behavior and system failure modes.

 - Expand risk monitoring into new areas, including cybersecurity threats and model loss-of-control or sabotage scenarios, in partnership with domain experts.

 - Communicate results to technical and executive stakeholders with crisp narratives, decision-ready metrics, and clear tradeoffs.

You might thrive in this role if you are:

 - An autonomous operator: you can take a problem statement and independently structure the analysis end-to-end.

 - Strong at executive-ready communication: concise, clear, and outcome-oriented.

 - Skilled in turning analysis into productable changes: you’re comfortable influencing across functions to drive mitigation improvements.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant experience in data science or applied analytics in high-stakes domains (e.g., security, trust & safety, abuse prevention, fraud, platform integrity, or reliability).

 - Strong foundations in experimentation, causal thinking, and/or observational inference; ability to design robust measurement under imperfect data.

 - Fluency in SQL and Python (or equivalent) for analysis, modeling, and building monitoring workflows.

 - Experience building metrics, dashboards, and operational monitoring that meaningfully changes outcomes (not just reporting).

 - Track record of driving cross-functional impact with engineering, product, and research partners.

 - Cybersecurity data science experience (strong preference), including exposure to threat modeling, adversarial dynamics, abuse patterns, or security telemetry.

 - Experience with classifier evaluation, calibration, thresholding, and error analysis at scale.
   Familiarity with detection systems in adversarial settings (e.g., evasion, distribution shift, feedback loops).

 - Trust & Safety experience is helpful, but not required.

 - Genuine interest in AI safety, alignment, and catastrophic risk prevention.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.jd: Job Title Senior Financial Analyst Job Description Summary The Finance Analyst supports financial planning, analysis, reporting, and finance-process automation for the account. Process Automation & Improvement · Assess recurring finance activities and identify opportunities to eliminate manual steps and process risk. · Develop and maintain automated finance tools, workflows, and controls using Power BI, Power Automate, Power Query, Excel, and related platforms. · Translate business requirements into practical, scalable solutions and coordinate testing, documentation, implementation, and user adoption. · Monitor automated processes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve performance and reliability. Monitor goodwill expenses, support forecasting, and identify campaign-related costs and dealers with high expenses and low customer satisfaction results. Analyze warranty repair data alongside technician training records to identify potential relationships between training gaps and repeat repairs. Review dealer use of labor operation codes and warranty repairs, coordinating with Regional Warranty Managers when excessive or unusual activity requires investigation. Conduct repair-sequence and repair-narrative analyses to assess dealer repair efficiency and potential effects on vehicle quality. Review vehicle buyback repair records, service orders, and customer communications to identify the initial and final defective causal parts and/or conditions associated with repurchase. Collaborate with Quality Engineers and internal departments to clarify technical findings and accurately document buyback conclusions. Enter and maintain warranty, claim, and buyback findings in designated internal systems. Prepare reports, presentations, and ad hoc analyses for management. Participate in training and product-information exchanges; travel, including overnight stays, may be required for up to four weeks annually. Support occasional vehicle testing, service coordination, and other related assignments as directed. Technical Expertise Strong understanding of automotive repair procedures, diagnostic methods, and vehicle systems. Ability to interpret repair orders, warranty claims, service histories, and technical documentation. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, and Word. Ability to analyze warranty costs, failure rates, claim trends, and forecast variances. Strong data-entry accuracy and documentation practices. Desired Skills Strong analytical, mathematical, and root-cause investigation skills. Exceptional attention to detail when reviewing technical records and documenting findings. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to explain analytical findings clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Strong organization, prioritization, multitasking, and follow-up skills. Ability to collaborate with client personnel, dealership staff, engineers, and warranty teams. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency is a plus. Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent. Experience in automotive repair and product quality. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data and develop clear findings and recommendations. Strong computer proficiency, including database querying and Microsoft Office applications. Ability to manage multiple assignments while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines. Preferred Qualifications Four-year degree in engineering. Dealership fixed operations and warranty experience. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement
jobs.jd:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement to turn complex financial and business questions into reliable data products, clear analyses, and actionable recommendations. You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will combine the technical depth of analytics engineering with strong analytical judgment and close partnership with Strategic Finance. Your work will serve both executive reviews and the teams making day-to-day business decisions.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Define and maintain trusted metrics and analytical datasets for revenue, usage, customer performance, compute consumption, and margin, with clear definitions and appropriate product, customer, and cohort detail.

 - Build automated dashboards and recurring reporting that help Finance leaders and operating teams understand performance, spot changes, and prioritize investigation.

 - Explain movements in business results and variances against expectations by examining underlying drivers, validating data quality, and distinguishing evidence from assumptions.

 - Translate ambiguous questions about growth, retention, monetization, pricing, and resource efficiency into structured analyses and practical recommendations.

 - Partner with forecasting specialists and Finance to provide reliable inputs, driver analyses, and scenario assumptions for forecasts and long-range plans.

 - Work with Data Engineering to improve the quality and usability of underlying data, and develop reusable analytical models and workflows that reduce manual effort.

 - Communicate findings clearly, align stakeholders on trade-offs, and follow through to understand whether the analysis or data product improved the decision.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have strong SQL and analytical data-modeling skills, and experience turning large, complex datasets into reliable analyses and reusable data products.

 - Can reason carefully about metrics, cohorts, denominators, measurement changes, and uncertainty, and investigate whether an unexpected result reflects the business or the data.

 - Have built dashboards or recurring reporting used by business partners, and can explain the decisions they enabled.

 - Bring sound business judgment and can independently scope an ambiguous problem, prioritize the work, and deliver an end-to-end solution.

 - Communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively with Finance, data scientists, engineers, and other business partners.

 - Can use Python or a comparable analytical tool to investigate data and automate repetitive work.

jobs.jd: Summary: The Data Scientist, Marketing Analytics serves as a core analytical authority on ADT’s marketing efforts, translating complex customer, campaign, and media data into high-value, predictive, and actionable insights. This role bridges the gap between advanced data science and strategic marketing operations, working with stakeholders to solve critical business problems like predicting high-value customer acquisitions, optimizing media spend, and supporting our company's growth, customer lifetime value (LTV), and digital personalization objectives. The ideal candidate combines strong technical capabilities in machine learning, statistical modeling, and data engineering with an understanding of consumer behavior, marketing technology (MarTech), and executive storytelling. They will work alongside the Marketing Analytics Leader, data analysts, data engineers, and channel managers to build scalable, evidence-based solutions that directly influence ADT’s customer acquisition and retention strategies. Duties and Responsibilities: Predictive Growth Modeling: Apply advanced statistical methods, machine learning (e.g., classification, survival analysis), and clustering to predict customer lifetime value (LTV), model acquisition propensity, and identify customer churn risk. Attribution & Mix Modeling: Support the development of Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and multi-touch attribution (MTA) frameworks to help business leaders understand and act on marketing efficiency issues. Campaign Experimentation: Design and execute evidence-based research and scientific hypothesis testing (A/B and multivariate testing) around digital marketing campaigns, creative assets, and landing page personalization. Executive Data Storytelling: Translate highly complex statistical findings into clear, beautiful, and intuitive visualizations and compelling narratives that drive strategy, action, and decision-making at executive levels. Data Engineering & Pipelines: Collaborate with data platform and engineering teams to design, implement, and maintain robust data pipelines that integrate ad-platform APIs, web analytics, and offline sales data into a continuous, single-source-of-truth. Privacy & Compliance: Implement and champion rigorous data privacy standards and ethical data collection practices, navigating how to effectively target and optimize campaigns while respecting consumer privacy regulations (e.g., CCPA/CPRA, cookie changes). Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with Brand, Digital Media, Demand Gen, and Product Marketing teams to frame vague marketing challenges into structured, measurable data science initiatives. Continuous Improvement: Stay current on evolving marketing technology trends, MLOps best practices, and innovative data sources to elevate ADT's analytical maturity from descriptive reporting to prescriptive action. Customer Segmentation: Experience creating and defining customer personas and segmentation to deliver personalized experiences throughout the customer lifecycle. Minimum Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related highly quantitative field. (Master's degree preferred). Experience: 3+ years of directly applicable experience in data science, predictive modeling, and building end-to-end data pipelines within a marketing or customer acquisition context. Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in (Python with deep experience in data modeling packages. Advanced SQL skills and experience manipulating high-dimensional consumer datasets. Proficiency using Vertex AI/Colab notebooks. Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of digital marketing channels (Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic), web analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics), and MarTech/AdTech ecosystems. Ambiguity Management: Proven ability to navigate dynamic, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial environments with ambiguous or evolving project requirements. Familiarity with Customer Data Platforms (CDP) in supporting no code/low code Marketer driven target audiences.
